title: #374 – Robert Playter: Boston Dynamics CEO on Humanoid and Legged Robotics
summary: Robert Playter is CEO of Boston Dynamics, a legendary robotics company that over 30 years has created some of the most elegant, dextrous, and simply amazing robots ever built, including the humanoid robot Atlas and the robot dog Spot.
